nodes.name: Doss Canvas Prep
nodes.description: Fit, fill, or stretch an image and mask together. Fit pads; fill center-crops. An absent mask means the entire source is selected.
nodes.advantage: One geometry operation keeps image and mask aligned through resize, center crop, or padding.

nodes.name: Doss Image Transform
nodes.description: Translate, rotate clockwise, and scale an image and its mask around their center with identical geometry. Exposed edges become zero.
nodes.advantage: Translate, rotate, and scale the image and its mask with the same sampling grid.

nodes.name: Doss Layer Composite
nodes.description: Place a foreground using pixel offsets and an optional white-is-selected mask. Supports singleton foreground batches and RGBA alpha.
nodes.advantage: Place a masked layer with opacity and blending, and reuse the resulting coverage mask.

nodes.name: Doss Color Match
nodes.description: Match per-channel RGB means and standard deviations to a reference. Strength blends the correction; alpha is preserved. Connect to Doss Image Comparer to review.
nodes.advantage: Blend per-channel reference statistics by strength without loading a color model.

nodes.name: Doss Image Comparer
nodes.description: Compare two images visually and pass the selected tensors through.
nodes.advantage: Name two takes, show supplied settings, and keep both original pass-through outputs.

nodes.name: Doss Mask Refine
nodes.description: Refine in this order: grow/shrink, Gaussian feather, optional threshold. White pixels select an area.
nodes.advantage: Combine signed growth, feathering, and optional threshold in a single ordered operation.

nodes.name: Doss Mask Combine
nodes.description: Combine equal-sized masks: union=max, intersection=min, subtract=clamped A-B, difference=abs(A-B). A single mask can broadcast over a batch.
nodes.advantage: Choose four explicit mask operations with strict spatial validation and singleton broadcast.

nodes.name: Doss Mask Preview
nodes.description: Create a colored mask overlay and pass the original mask through. Connect overlay to Preview Image or Doss Image Comparer.
nodes.advantage: Preview a colored overlay while passing the original mask onward unchanged.

nodes.name: Doss Mask From Channels
nodes.description: Select pixels within an inclusive channel/luminance range. Alpha requires an RGBA image; core Load Image supplies transparency separately as a mask.
nodes.advantage: Select an inclusive range from RGB, alpha, or luminance with optional inversion.

nodes.name: Doss Clip Trim
nodes.description: Trim a native video in seconds or frames. End is exclusive; end=0 means the end of the clip. Audio follows the same range.
nodes.advantage: Trim native VIDEO by time or frame index while retaining synchronized audio.

nodes.name: Doss Clip Join
nodes.description: Join two compatible native clips and align audio to the frame boundary. Materializes short clips in memory; max_frames limits the combined output.
nodes.advantage: Check clip compatibility and align audio sample boundaries before joining.

nodes.name: Doss Shot Sheet
nodes.description: Make a labeled contact sheet plus selected IMAGE frames from a short native video. Enter indices/slices or leave blank for evenly spaced samples. The source remains unchanged.
nodes.advantage: Get timestamped contact sheets and the exact selected frame batch together.

nodes.name: Doss Motion Settings | LTX 2.5
nodes.description: Keep LTX prompt, duration, frame count, seed, and motion controls together.
nodes.advantage: Keep LTX prompt, duration, frame count, seed, and motion controls together.

nodes.name: Doss Motion Studio | LTX 2.5
nodes.description: Draw and restore LTX motion tracks directly over the source image.
nodes.advantage: Draw and restore LTX motion tracks directly over the source image.

nodes.name: Doss Resolve Motion Tracks | LTX 2.5
nodes.description: Resolve the saved motion plan against explicit source geometry and frame count.
nodes.advantage: Resolve the saved motion plan against explicit source geometry and frame count.

nodes.name: Doss Audio Finish
nodes.description: Trim, apply gain or per-item peak normalization, then fade. Silence stays silent. Samples over full scale are reported instead of silently clipped. Duration=0 keeps the remainder.
nodes.advantage: Trim, gain, normalize, and fade together, with feedback when samples exceed full scale.

nodes.name: Doss Prompt Recipe
nodes.description: Assemble ordered named sections. JSON entries use name, text, and optional enabled. Returns exact text and a recipe record; no AI or model is needed.
nodes.advantage: Keep named sections and their enabled states alongside an exact assembled prompt preview.

nodes.name: Doss Text Toolkit
nodes.description: Clean whitespace, replace literal text, join strings, or extract a dotted JSON path (arrays use numeric indices). Never evaluates code or regular expressions.
nodes.advantage: Use literal text operations and JSON extraction without expressions or custom scripts.

nodes.name: Doss Seed Sequence
nodes.description: Derive a repeatable seed from base + index × step, wrapping at 2^53. This range round-trips exactly through browser workflow JSON.
nodes.advantage: Reproduce any indexed experiment directly, without relying on queue history.

nodes.name: Doss Value Schedule
nodes.description: Evaluate ordered [index,value] keyframes with linear or stepped interpolation. Holds endpoints outside the range; supplies curve data to the node preview.
nodes.advantage: Evaluate explicit linear or stepped keyframes and inspect the curve on the node.

nodes.name: Doss Model Inventory
nodes.description: List installed model names by category without loading weights, downloading files, or exposing absolute filesystem paths. Refreshes each run.
nodes.advantage: Inspect model availability without loading weights or changing the installation.

nodes.name: Doss Multi-LoRA Loader
nodes.description: Add, remove, enable, and weight multiple LoRAs in one ordered loader. Each enabled LoRA is applied to MODEL and CLIP in displayed order.
nodes.advantage: Reorder an entire LoRA stack with independent model and CLIP weights and legacy schema migration.

nodes.name: Doss Sampling Preset
nodes.description: Keep sampling parameters together while wiring each value to standard sampler inputs. Saves exact settings, without changing the model or assuming an optimal preset.
nodes.advantage: Keep related sampler settings together and wire standard typed outputs to core samplers.

nodes.name: Doss Resolution Plan
nodes.description: Set a target long edge and aspect ratio, then snap dimensions to an explicit multiple. Reports the resulting aspect error; does not infer model requirements.
nodes.advantage: Choose aspect ratio and divisibility explicitly and inspect the resulting aspect error.

nodes.name: Doss Typed Switch
nodes.description: Select A or B of an explicit native type. Only the selected branch executes. Change data_type before connecting; incompatible links are rejected.
nodes.advantage: Choose a native data type and evaluate only the selected upstream branch.

nodes.name: Doss Batch Select
nodes.description: Select image or mask items using comma-separated indices and slices such as 0,2,4:10:2. Negative indices count from the end; duplicates preserve requested order.
nodes.advantage: Pick exact image or mask takes, slices, and repeated indices in the requested order.

nodes.name: Doss Batch Join
nodes.description: Concatenate two compatible image or mask batches. Dimensions, channels, dtype, and device must agree. Never silently resizes or converts your inputs.
nodes.advantage: Join compatible image or mask batches with a count and clear mismatch errors.

nodes.name: Doss Table Input
nodes.description: Select one row from CSV with a header or a JSON array of objects. Pair row_json with Text Toolkit → json_field; row_index is explicit and repeatable.
nodes.advantage: Drive indexed experiments from embedded CSV or JSON without another file dependency.

nodes.name: Doss Workflow Timer and Alarm
nodes.description: Watch queue lifecycle and hear a completion alarm without adding processing wires.
nodes.advantage: Watch queue lifecycle and hear a completion alarm without adding processing wires.

nodes.name: Doss Inspector
nodes.description: Inspect tensor dimensions, devices, ranges, and non-finite counts without changing the input. Reports structure rather than prompt text, credentials, or tensor contents.
nodes.advantage: Inspect shape, batch, dtype, ranges, and non-finite counts while passing the value through.

nodes.name: Doss Save Image
nodes.description: Save images to the ComfyUI output folder or an output subfolder.
nodes.advantage: Keep the existing seven formats and output paths, with optional structured run records.

nodes.name: Doss Video Output Pack
nodes.description: Save a native video with synchronized audio and an optional versioned run record, inside ComfyUI output. Uses native encoding and collision-safe filenames.
nodes.advantage: Save native video and audio with collision-safe paths and a record of timing and encoding settings.

nodes.name: Doss Label Maker
nodes.description: Add styled canvas labels without adding executable prompt nodes.
nodes.advantage: Organize the canvas with saved typography, colors, and text; labels stay out of API prompts.

workflows.name: Diagnostics essentials
workflows.description: Inspect an image batch and check installed LoRA filenames without loading weights.

workflows.name: Output essentials
